character: DJ Gifted Prophet — a young man with olive skin, Ray-Ban nerdy glasses, a goatee, wearing a black baseball cap with white letters 'LL' on the front. He is the DJ/performer and the 'prophet on the chain'.
concept: Derived purely from the lyrics. DJ Gifted Prophet moves through LA while the 'chain' (on-chain ledger) is visualized as something physical he engraves, carries, and verifies — park bench scripts, hash codes in a dark trench, a West side slow ride, digital caves glowing, names etched in steel, scripture palm trees. The through-line: 'check the chain, see what's real'. West Coast neon-decay palette, 90s MTV grain. SMALL percentage of scenes are slow-mo (scenes 2 and 9) per prior feedback. No on-screen text.
